scripts.test:stage5: npm run build:extension && npm run build:native && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File tests/stage5/run.ps1
scripts.test:stage6: npm run build:extension && npm run build:native && node --test tests/stage6/*.test.mjs
scripts.install:native: npm run build:native && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/install-native-host.ps1 -Action Install
scripts.upgrade:native: npm run build:native && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/install-native-host.ps1 -Action Upgrade
scripts.check:extension: npm run typecheck && npm run test:extension
scripts.check:stage2: npm run check:stage1 && npm run test:stage2
scripts.check:stage3: npm run check:stage2 && npm run test:stage3
scripts.check:stage4: npm run check:stage3 && npm run test:stage4
scripts.check:stage5: npm run check:stage4 && npm run check:extension && npm run check:native && npm run test:stage5
scripts.check:stage6: npm run check:stage5 && npm run test:stage6
scripts.check:stage6:ui: npm run check:extension && npm run test:stage6:ui
scripts.check:stage7: npm run check:stage6:ui && npm run check:native && npm run test:stage7
